claims: In the pinned Redline i386 preview routine, each wheel runtime travel at +0x47c is initialized to 0.5 times configured wheels.maxSuspension (config +0x18); both simple and detailed wheel draw paths subtract this travel from configured wheels.pos.y. A static model matching this native preview therefore uses center [pos.x, pos.y - 0.5*maxSuspension, pos.z]. This is preview pose, not a claim about runtime physics equilibrium.

For an omitted wheels.maxSuspension, the native config loader zero-initializes the numWheels * 0x58 allocation with _NewPtrClear; its maxSuspension handler writes wheel +0x18 through sscanf only on the matching field. In this configuration-loading branch the missing-field fallback is therefore 0.0. Finite/nonnegative conversion checks are separate safeguards and are not native loader validation.
